recap.text: Read the club's flyer; Muse Ember; 2.1 seconds
recap.source: One capture pass by the deck builder on 2026-11-13 between 3:40 and 4:30 AM PT, against a local production build of main with the Muse key linked and the server clock set to the demo clock (3:05 PM ET; motion/opening/tools/demo-clock.cjs). Each run loads the real screen in a 390 x 844 frame as the stage does, as the right person, and reads the app's own time stamp (motion/opening/tools/recap-pass.mjs; every run in motion/opening/recap-pass.json). Steps the app keeps per run (re-plan, picks, hello) ran once per fresh server. The deck shows the median run's screen and that run's own number, so they cannot disagree. Flyer read, as Jing (/organizer?handoff=story; the page calls /api/muse/extract/events with the flyer): runs 2.8, 2.8, 1.7, 2.1, 1.7 s, median 2.1 s, shown with that run's screen (Read in 2.1 s). Model: muse-ember-1.0 (lib/muse/client.ts).
